outline:
數位媒材有效的結合（1）數位設計、（2）數位評估、與（3）數位製造、這三個向度，改善了過去設計與評估之間的裂痕，並且助益於造就永續營造體系。本課程以數位評估的探討為主軸，運用數位軟體模擬光音熱氣水等建築物理現象，並配合綠色科技建築觀念，檢視設計的合理性，期能藉模擬反應設計問題、並且提供多樣的解決方案。
Digital media can be applied to spatial design with spectacular results, and can also be effectively combined with digital design, digital evaluation, and digital manufacturing. In combination with these three dimensions, digital media can bridge the past gap between design and evaluation, and facilitate the achievement of high-precision, pre-cast, low-pollution, practical digital sustainable construction systems. This class explores the new dimension of digital evaluation and uses digital tool to simulate architectural physical phenomenon like lighting, sound, heat and humid etc. And cooperating with the concepts of green technology, It exams designs’ feasibility and reasonability.  The goal of this course is to reflect design problems by simulation and also  providing diverse resolutions.
